title: Volvo FM FUPS Hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #25
description: Volvo FM-FH FUPS Lowline Radar Compatible bull bar. This bar is designed to allow for the grill to be opened without dropping the Bullbar assembly. The lower box uprights still give maximum protection to the cab with the ease of access for daily maintenance checks. All tube is 76mm diameter hi-tensile aluminium. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with heavy duty tow pin. Hinged fold down Oversize sign. Driving lights can be mounted as required. One set of roo-slicers for additional headlight protection.
